en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large wooden building in a rural setting, surrounded by trees and a garden or orchard. The structure has a gabled roof with dormers, multiple windows, and open verandas on the right side. In the foreground is a dirt path lined with flowering trees. At the bottom margin is printed text identifying the place, along with a handwritten-looking signature on the right.
